```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
mutation_unique <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mutation_rate_thaliana/Unique_mutations.csv", sep=",", header=T)
mutation_shared <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mutation_rate_thaliana/Shared_mutations.csv", sep=",", header=T)

## Read orthologous genes
pannagram_1_1_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/coordinates_without_genes.csv", header=T, sep=",")
## Attach thaliana start and end
genes_athaliana <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")  %>% filter(V3=="gene")
genes_athaliana$gene_id <- sub(".*ID=([^;]+);.*", "\\1", genes_athaliana$V9)
genes_athaliana[, gene_id_clean := sub("Parent=([^.]+)\\..*", "\\1", gene_id)]
genes_athaliana <- genes_athaliana %>% dplyr::select(V1,V4,V5,gene_id_clean)
colnames(genes_athaliana) <- c("chr_thal", "star_thal", "end_thal", "gene_id_thal")
## Connect coordinates to genes 
pannagram_1_1_genes <- inner_join(pannagram_1_1_genes,genes_athaliana, by=c("sequence"="gene_id_thal"))
# Get necessary columns
pannagram_1_1_genes <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>% dplyr::select(sequence,chr_thal,star_thal,end_thal)
```
## Reproduce paper result
```{r}
# Get all unique MA lines that appear anywhere in mutation_shared
shared_lines <- unique(c(
  mutation_shared$MA_Line1,
  mutation_shared$MA_Line2,
  mutation_shared$MA_Line3,
  mutation_shared$MA_Line4
))

shared_lines <- shared_lines[!is.na(shared_lines)]
## Exclude shared lines
mutation_unique_clean <- mutation_unique %>%
  filter(!MA_Line %in% shared_lines)
# Filter out mutation shared by multiple lines
mutation_shared_many_lines <-mutation_shared[mutation_shared$MA_Line1=="shared_by_56_lines" |mutation_shared$MA_Line1=="shared_by_15_lines", ]
# Remove mutations shared by many lines
mutation_unique_clean <- mutation_unique %>%
  filter(!(paste(CHROM, POS) %in% paste(mutation_shared_many_lines$CHROM, mutation_shared_many_lines$POS)))
# Check remaining lines
mutation_unique_clean <- mutation_unique_clean %>%
  filter(!MA_Line %in% shared_mutation_lines)

# Filter only single mutation
mutation_unique_clean <-mutation_unique_clean[mutation_unique_clean$Type=="SNM",]

```

```{r}
# Count unique SNMs per region
# Heterochormatin defined peri-centromeres
peri_centromeres <- data.frame(
  chromosome   = c("Chr1", "Chr2", "Chr3", "Chr4", "Chr5"),
  start = c(8500000, 0, 9250000, 1000000, 8500000),
  end   = c(24500000, 10500000, 17250000, 11000000, 18000000)
)
centromeres <- read.csv2('/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz2023.txt',header=T, sep="\t")
centromeres$start <- as.numeric(centromeres$start)
centromeres$stop <-as.numeric(centromeres$stop)
centromeres$chromosome <- paste0("Chr", centromeres$chrom)

## Exclude centromeres from peri-centromeres 
peri_only <- peri_centromeres %>%
  left_join(centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, start_cen = start, end_cen = stop), 
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # pericentromeric region has two parts: left and right of centromere
    left_bp  = pmax(0, start_cen - start),
    right_bp = pmax(0, end - end_cen),
    peri_bp  = left_bp + right_bp,
    cen_bp   = end_cen - start_cen,
    callable_peri = peri_bp * 0.93,
    callable_cen  = cen_bp * 0.93
  )

peri_only

# Calculate callable sites 
total_callable_peri <- sum(peri_only$callable_peri)
total_callable_cen  <- sum(peri_only$callable_cen)

total_callable_peri
total_callable_cen
# Get chromosome length 
chromosome_length <-read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/chrom_length.csv", sep=";", header=T)
# Add chromosome column to match
chromosome_length <- chromosome_length %>%
  mutate(chromosome = paste0("Chr", chrom))
# Calculate arm callable sites
arms <- chromosome_length %>%
  left_join(peri_centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, peri_start = start, peri_end = end),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(
    arm_bp       = length_chrom - (peri_end - peri_start),  # total chr minus peri-centromeric region
    callable_arm = arm_bp * 0.93
  )

arms
total_callable_arms <- sum(arms$callable_arm)
total_callable_arms
```
## Calculate mutation rate everywhere (genes+TEs)
```{r}
#mutation_unique_clean$TAIR_ID %in% pannagram_1_1_genes$thaliana_id
n_lines <- n_distinct(mutation_unique_clean$MA_Line)
generations <- 25

# Count SNMs per region
snm_peri <- mutation_unique_clean %>%
  filter(Chromosome_region == "pericentromeric") %>%
  nrow()
snm_cen <- mutation_unique_clean %>%
  filter(Chromosome_region == "centromere") %>%
  nrow()
snm_arms <- mutation_unique_clean %>%
  filter(Chromosome_region == "chromosome-arm") %>%
  nrow()

snm_peri; snm_cen; snm_arms

# Mutation rates
mutation_rate_peri <- snm_peri / (n_lines * generations * total_callable_peri)
mutation_rate_cen  <- snm_cen  / (n_lines * generations * total_callable_cen)
mutation_rate_arms <- snm_arms / (n_lines * generations * total_callable_arms)

mutation_rate_peri
mutation_rate_cen
mutation_rate_arms

mutation_rate_peri/mutation_rate_arms

# Visualize with poisson test
mut <- tribble(
  ~region,          ~snm,      ~callable,
  "Chromosome arms", snm_arms, total_callable_arms,
  "Pericentromere",  snm_peri, total_callable_peri,
  "Centromere",      snm_cen,  total_callable_cen
) %>%
  mutate(
    denom = n_lines * generations * callable,
    rate  = snm / denom,
    lo    = sapply(snm, function(x) poisson.test(x)$conf.int[1]) / denom,
    hi    = sapply(snm, function(x) poisson.test(x)$conf.int[2]) / denom,
    region = factor(region,
             levels = c("Chromosome arms", "Pericentromere", "Centromere"))
  )
# plot
ggplot(mut, aes(x = region, y = rate, color = region)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Chromosome arms" = "#d1e5f0",
                                "Pericentromere"  = "#f4a582",
                                "Centromere"      = "#b2182b")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mutation rate (per site per generation)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


## Calculate mutation rate in orthologous genes 

```{r}
# Assign gene to be in peri-centromere or arm 
# Assign each gene to pericentromeric or arm region
pannagram_1_1_genes <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  left_join(peri_centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, peri_start = start, peri_end = end),
            by = c("chr_thal" = "chromosome")) %>%
  mutate(
    region = case_when(
      star_thal >= peri_start & end_thal <= peri_end ~ "pericentromeric",
      TRUE ~ "arm"
    )
  )

# Calculate callable sites per gene
pannagram_1_1_genes <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  mutate(
    gene_length    = end_thal - star_thal,
    callable_sites = gene_length * 0.93
  )
callable_by_region <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_genes         = n(),
    total_callable  = sum(callable_sites),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
# Filter mutations to those in orthologous genes
mutation_ortho <- mutation_unique_clean %>%
  filter(TAIR_ID %in% pannagram_1_1_genes$sequence) %>%
  left_join(pannagram_1_1_genes %>% dplyr::select(sequence, region),
            by = c("TAIR_ID" = "sequence"))

# Count SNMs per region
snm_ortho_peri <- sum(mutation_ortho$region == "pericentromeric", na.rm = TRUE)
snm_ortho_arm  <- sum(mutation_ortho$region == "arm", na.rm = TRUE)

# Callable sites per region (from orthologous genes only)
callable_ortho_peri <- callable_by_region %>% filter(region == "pericentromeric") %>% pull(total_callable)
callable_ortho_arm  <- callable_by_region %>% filter(region == "arm")             %>% pull(total_callable)

# Mutation rates
mut_rate_ortho_peri <- snm_ortho_peri / (n_lines * generations * callable_ortho_peri)
mut_rate_ortho_arm  <- snm_ortho_arm  / (n_lines * generations * callable_ortho_arm)

mut_rate_ortho_peri/mut_rate_ortho_arm
```

```{r}
# Plot mutations in orthologous genes
mut_ortho <- tribble(
  ~region,           ~snm,            ~callable,
  "Chromosome arms", snm_ortho_arm,   callable_ortho_arm,
  "Pericentromere",  snm_ortho_peri,  callable_ortho_peri
) %>%
  mutate(
    denom = n_lines * generations * callable,
    rate  = snm / denom,
    lo    = sapply(snm, function(x) poisson.test(x)$conf.int[1]) / denom,
    hi    = sapply(snm, function(x) poisson.test(x)$conf.int[2]) / denom,
    region = factor(region, levels = c("Chromosome arms", "Pericentromere"))
  )

ggplot(mut_ortho, aes(x = region, y = rate, color = region)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Chromosome arms" = "#d1e5f0",
                                "Pericentromere"  = "#67001f")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mutation rate (per site per generation)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
## Combined plot of mutation rate 
```{r}
# Combine into one dataset
mut <- tribble(
  ~region,          ~snm,      ~callable,
  "Chromosome arms", snm_arms, total_callable_arms,
  "Pericentromere",  snm_peri, total_callable_peri
) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "Whole genome")
mut_ortho <- tribble(
  ~region,           ~snm,           ~callable,
  "Chromosome arms", snm_ortho_arm,  callable_ortho_arm,
  "Pericentromere",  snm_ortho_peri, callable_ortho_peri
) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "Orthologous genes")
# Combine
mut_combined <- bind_rows(mut, mut_ortho) %>%
  mutate(
    denom  = n_lines * generations * callable,
    rate   = snm / denom,
    lo     = sapply(snm, function(x) poisson.test(x)$conf.int[1]) / denom,
    hi     = sapply(snm, function(x) poisson.test(x)$conf.int[2]) / denom,
    region = factor(region, levels = c("Chromosome arms", "Pericentromere")),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c("Whole genome", "Orthologous genes"))
  )
# Plot
ggplot(mut_combined, aes(x = region, y = rate, color = dataset)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Whole genome"      = "#4d4d4d",
                                "Orthologous genes" = "#d6604d")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mutation rate (per site per generation)", color = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
# Significance level
stars <- function(p) as.character(cut(p, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
                                      labels = c("***", "**", "*", "NS")))

test_dataset <- function(ds) {
  d    <- mut_combined %>% filter(dataset == ds)
  arm  <- d %>% filter(region == "Chromosome arms")
  peri <- d %>% filter(region == "Pericentromere")
  poisson.test(c(arm$snm, peri$snm), c(arm$denom, peri$denom))$p.value
}

sig <- mut_combined %>%
  filter(region == "Chromosome arms") %>%    
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(y = mean(rate), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    p     = sapply(as.character(dataset), test_dataset),
    label = stars(p),
    x     = 0.7                         
  )
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.3)
mutation_rate <- ggplot(mut_combined, aes(x = region, y = rate, color = dataset, group = dataset)) +
  geom_line(position = pd, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7, position = pd) +
  geom_point(size = 16, position = pd) +
  geom_text(data = sig, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            size = 12, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Whole genome" = "#4d4d4d",
                                "Orthologous genes" = "#d6604d")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Chromosome arms" = "Arm"),
                   expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 0.3))) +   # room on the left
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) x / 1e-9) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = expression("Mutation rate (" * 10^-9 * ")"),
       color = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 36) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/mutation_rate_analysis.png",
       plot = mutation_rate,
       width = 300, height = 250, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```
